thread:
Sarah (CS): quick kickoff — AcmeHealth onboarding. We got the vendor form back, flagged some security gaps. summary below.

Mike (SE): ok, what are the top items? i can triage with eng.

Jordan (Security): high-level: SOC2 scope unclear, envs with PII in non-prod, missing key rotation evidence, BYOK questions.

Olivia (Onboarding PM): timeline: customer wants go-live in 3 weeks. need to mark must-haves vs nice-to-have.

Sarah (CS): must-haves: DPA signed, SOC2 scope confirmation, list of subprocessors, KMS location (us/eu), nonprod data handling policy.

Mike (SE): I can provide sample infra diagram + nonprod isolation notes. pinging eng infra for confirmation.

Jordan (Security): request: send SOC2 sysdesc PDF + control owner contact. also need proof of key rotation policy (doc or screenshot).

Sarah (CS): can we bundle into a single response by EOD Fri? customer slack pref: acme-ps@example.com

Olivia (Onboarding PM): action items:
```
- Mike: infra diagram + nonprod controls (due Thu)
- Jordan: SOC2 snippet + key rotation evidence (due Thu)
- Sarah: assemble response + tracker, send DPA template (due Fri)
``` 

Mike (SE): noted. I'll attach diagram and a short note about KV caching and token logs (no PII stored) :thumbsup:

Jordan (Security): also confirm KMS ownership model: Redwood-managed vs customer BYOK. Acme asked for BYOK.

Sarah (CS): customer asked about retention for embeddings. we should add retention policy and pseudonymization note.

compliance-bot: Ticket CS-1245 created for "AcmeHealth onboarding - security docs" (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-1245)

Olivia (Onboarding PM): ok. if we miss DPA by go-live, recommend canary limited dataset with strict ACLs until signed.

Mike (SE): quick Q: does engineering need test credentials from acme to validate nonprod scrubbing? @Sarah (CS) pls confirm.

Sarah (CS): yes they'll provide a scrubbed dataset. i'll request it today. also asking legal to fast-track DPA sign.

Jordan (Security): FYI: if they insist BYOK, we need timeline for KMS onboarding — can be +2 weeks. flagging as renewal risk if mandatory.

Sarah (CS): noted — i'll surface that to account. last: any objections to shipping a short FAQ to customer covering these points before Friday? 

Mike (SE): no objections.

Olivia (Onboarding PM): thumbs up. I'll update the onboarding checklist and link ticket in the tracker.

Sarah (CS): thanks team. will post updates here when docs are ready. :sparkles:
